company.name: Northstar
company.description: A marketplace for weekend trips. Travellers book stays and experiences on the web and in the app; most bookings happen on the web.

title: Northstar: bookings are slipping
brief: Conversion, the share of daily active users who book, fell 10% in the last 7 days compared with the week before. The design team shipped a redesigned checkout the same week and says users love it. Find out what is going on.

rootCause.summary: The redesigned web checkout converts far worse than the old one.
rootCause.explanation: Conversion fell only on the web, in every country and channel, from the day the new checkout reached all users. The apps, which kept the old checkout, convert as before.
rootCause.idealAction: Roll the web checkout back to the old version, then reintroduce the redesign as an A/B test with conversion as the primary metric.
idealPath: Break down by platform: only the web drops
Check that the web drop is the same in every country and channel
Rule out the paid search cut: it lowers signups, not the conversion rate

falseLeads.explanation: Halving paid search brings fewer new users, which lowers traffic, not the share of visitors who book.

annotations.label: New web checkout rolled out to 100%
Paid search budget cut by half
